scenarios.title: Early exit: -10 % within 72 h -> full sell
scenarios.question: Does cutting lots that fall 10 % in their first 72 h beat staging (Jul-Oct entries)?

variants.name: baseline
variants.description: staging stop/DCA code, recorded entries and adds

variants.name: early10_72h
variants.description: full sell when the lot is -10 % vs avg within 72 h of entry; closed lot takes no further adds

variants.name: early8_72h
variants.description: same, -8 %

variants.name: early12_72h
variants.description: same, -12 %

scenarios.title: No chasing: skip entry after >15 % 48 h pump
scenarios.question: Does skipping entries after a 48 h pump > 15 % beat staging?

variants.name: baseline
variants.description: all recorded entries

variants.name: nochase15
variants.description: skip entry if price > 15 % above the lowest 1h low of the 48 h before the signal

variants.name: nochase10
variants.description: skip entry if price > 10 % above the lowest 1h low of the 48 h before the signal

variants.name: nochase20
variants.description: skip entry if price > 20 % above the lowest 1h low of the 48 h before the signal

notes: Entries kept for lack of 48 h history (primary): 5.

scenarios.title: Combined: early exit + no chasing
scenarios.question: Do the exit and entry rules together beat staging?

variants.name: baseline
variants.description: staging, all recorded entries

variants.name: early10+nochase15
variants.description: (e) early10_72h + (g) nochase15

variants.name: stop15_noadd+nochase15
variants.description: (f) stop15_noadd + (g) nochase15
